reason: I'd go and look at them first. If the bend and crack report is in the listing and they check out in person, £280 for four 17s is a fair deal and the fit refund covers my PCD and offset worry. I wouldn't pay a penny before I've seen them on the day.
objection: Could they be cracked or bent? A new seller with no reviews and a photo can hide a lot, and a repaired kerb mark can hide a weak spot.
would_change_my_mind: If I couldn't check the set in person and have it on a balancer or hold it up to a straight edge before paying, it'd be a no.
